scenes.text: Imagine standing on a tiny, deserted island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean and claiming it for your country.
In 1856, the US passed a law making this legal, but only if the island was covered in bird poop.
Guano was the world's most valuable fertilizer, prompting American sailors to hunt the globe for white-crusted rocks.
Over one hundred islands were seized this way, so tell us the weirdest law you know in the comments and follow for more!
